title: Improved Attack Complexity for Two-Round Even-Mansour
summary: For the two-round Even-Mansour cipher, the best cited attack is the current baseline, and improving its time complexity remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the two-round Even-Mansour cipher, the best cited attack, due to Leurent and Sibleyras, has time complexity $O(2^n/\sqrt{n})$; the open problem is to develop an attack with improved time complexity.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of the two-round Even-Mansour cipher, centered on attack time complexity.
parameters: n: parameter appearing in the attack time-complexity expression
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop an attack on the two-round Even-Mansour cipher with improved time complexity.

progress.summary: The source explicitly identifies the analogous two-round Even-Mansour attack-complexity problem as open and records the Leurent and Sibleyras attack as the best cited baseline.
citation_labels: Tim Beyne et al., Provably Secure Reflection Ciphers
